cards.card_text: It also hauls in a great cargo of almug wood and precious stones.
cards.verse_text: (The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought from Ophir a great cargo of almug wood and precious stones.
cards.snippet: …brought gold from Ophir also brought from Ophir a great cargo of almug wood and precious stones.

cards.card_text: Solomon makes the almug wood into steps for the house of the LORD and the king's palace, and into lyres and harps for the ___.
cards.verse_text: The king made the almug wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers.
